functions.name: SetPageSize
functions.docs: Set the PageSize used read requests made to the LowerLevel Archive in PreloadBytes mode when reading bytes into the In-Memory cache. Invalid to set after Initialization; PageSize must be constant during use.

functions.name: InitializeAsync
functions.signature: InitializeAsync(Target, In Create Archive Function, In Flags, Prime Size)
functions.docs: Initialize the FPreloadableFile asynchronously, performing FileOpen operations on another thread. Use IsInitialized or WaitForInitialization to check progress.

functions.name: InitializeAsync
functions.signature: InitializeAsync(Target, In Create Async Archive Function, In Flags, Prime Size)

functions.name: IsInitialized
functions.docs: Return whether InitializeAsync has completed. If Close is called, state returns to false until the next call to InitializeAsync.

functions.name: WaitForInitialization
functions.docs: Wait for InitializeAsync to complete if it is running, otherwise return immediately.

functions.name: StartPreload
functions.docs: When in PreloadBytes mode, if not already preloading, allocate if necessary the memory for the preloaded bytes and start the chain of asynchronous ReadRequests for the bytes. Returns whether preloading is now active.

functions.name: StopPreload
functions.docs: Cancel any current asynchronous ReadRequests and wait for the asynchronous work to exit.

functions.name: IsPreloading
functions.docs: Return whether preloading is in progress. Value may not be up to date since asynchronous work might complete in a race condition.

functions.name: AllocateCache
functions.docs: When in PreloadBytes mode, allocate if necessary the memory for the preloaded bytes. Return whether the memory is now allocated.

functions.name: ReleaseCache
functions.docs: Free all memory used by the cache or for preloading (calling StopPreload if necessary).

functions.name: IsCacheAllocated
functions.docs: Return whether the cache is currently allocated.

functions.name: DetachLowerLevel
functions.docs: Return the LowerLevel FArchive if it has been allocated. May return null, even if the FPreloadableFile is currently active. If return value is non-null, caller is responsible for deleting it.

functions.name: HasValidData
functions.docs: Return whether this archive has an inner archive it can provide data out of. Serialize will fail if this returns false.

functions.name: TotalSize
functions.docs: Return the size of the file, or -1 if the file does not exist. This is also the amount of memory that will be allocated by AllocateCache.

functions.name: TryRegister
functions.docs:
Try to register the given FPreloadableFile instance to handle the next call to TryTakeArchive for its FileName.
Will fail if the instance has not been initialized or if another instance has already registered for the Filename.
Return whether the instance is currently registered. Returns true if the instance was already registered.
Registered files are referenced-counted, and the reference will not be dropped until (1) (TryTakeArchive or UnRegister is called) and (2) (PreloadBytes mode only) the archive returned from TryTakeArchive is deleted.

functions.name: TryTakeArchive
functions.docs:
Look up an FPreloadableFile instance registered for the given FileName, and return an FArchive from it.
If found, removes the registration so no future call to TryTakeArchive can sue the same FArchive.
If the instance is in PreloadHandle mode, the Lower-Level FArchive will be detached from the FPreloadableFile and returned using DetachLowerLevel.
If the instance is in PreloadBytes mode, a ProxyArchive will be returned that forwards call to the FPreloadableFile instance.

functions.name: UnRegister
functions.docs: Remove the FPreloadableFile instance if it is registered for its FileName. Returns whether the instance was registered.
